description:
🤠 Honky-Tonk Hostile: 

For Cowboys, Hippies & Fun-Lovers! ✌️Not fancy—just the best price 7 mins from downtown. 

Perfect for those who put fun over luxury and love being out and about.

Your Private Space:

Private room & bathroom Queen bed, AC, TV & desk 

Kitchen with cookware & coffeeOn-Site Perks:Real Irish Pub downstairs 

🍻24/7 Pool, Gym, & Game RoomOn-site events & 24/hr security

A straight shot downtown in under 10 minutes. Book your budget-friendly launchpad today!

The space
Not fancy, but full of heart. 

If you put fun over luxury, this is the best value just 7 mins to Broadway.

Your Private Music-Themed Studio: Nashville prints (crafted with care!)

Bed, work desk, & full private bath (walk-in shower) Kitchenette: Sink, microwave, mini-fridge, & coffee

On Property Perks:

Irish pub & restaurant 🍻Outdoor pool & very nice gym 

Lounge with pool table, ping-pong, & jukebox 

Free parking & 24/hr security

Guest access
The motel is all yours for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and feel at home.
In addition to the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with the following:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Self Check-In (FOB Lock) 
✔ Air Conditioning 
✔ Heating 
✔ Iron/Board
 ✔ Free Parking
 ✔ Outdoor seating area
✔ Outdoor pool
✔ Shared community gym
✔ Local Bar & Restaurant

Other things to note
🏠 House Rules & Policies

★ CLEANING & SANITIZATION ★
Your health and safety are our top priorities. We follow a rigorous, professional cleaning and sanitization process after every check-out to ensure a pristine stay.

★ PETS WELCOME ★
We love furry friends! Our home is pet-friendly, so feel free to bring your "bundles of joy" along for your Nashville adventure.
A fee of $35 per day, per pet applies to all bookings.

★ NO SMOKING ★
This is a strictly non-smoking property. To keep the air fresh for all guests, smoking inside will result in a $1,000 deep-cleaning and odor-removal fee.

★ NO PARTIES OR EVENTS ★
Please treat our home with the same respect you would your own. To maintain a peaceful environment for the complex, parties and large gatherings are not permitted.

★ KEY FOB POLICY ★
Access to the building is via a secure key fob. Please keep track of your fob during your stay!

Replacement Fee: There is a $75 non-refundable fee for any lost or unreturned key fobs.

★ EARLY CHECK IN /LATE CHECK-OUT ★
To keep our cleaning team on schedule for the next guest, early arrivals or late departures are subject to a $35/hour fee and must be requested in advance.
